Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.reporting

Class TwoFluidPipeReport.LowPointPoolSnapshot

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.reporting.TwoFluidPipeReport.LowPointPoolSnapshot
Enclosing class:
TwoFluidPipeReport
public static final class TwoFluidPipeReport.LowPointPoolSnapshot extends Object
Immutable per-terrain-basin liquid-pool snapshot at one simulation time.

Pool identifiers are one-based for reporting. Cell and basin indices are zero-based and refer to the physical TwoFluidSection array. A basin is reported only for a strict internal terrain minimum; an exactly flat minimum is represented by its midpoint cell. Horizontal and monotonic profiles therefore produce an empty snapshot instead of manufacturing a pool location.
